reading: The sketch is a dark hero landing page: two thin rules frame a nav bar, a giant outlined "3" sits upper right, a two-line huge headline and a smaller paragraph sit lower left, a pill button sits below them, and three overlapping glass-card shapes plus three colour glows are specified via typed notes anchored to the top/bottom rule strokes.

actions.instruction: Add 3 soft blurred colour glow divs behind all content: position absolute, z-index 0, no border/text, border-radius 50%, filter: blur(60px). Glow 1: 420x420px a
Add a giant heavy hollow-outlined white live-text "3" (font-family Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight 900; round-bowled, not squared/condensed/display):
Add a nav bar with no surrounding box: bold "PRISMA" on the left, and "Product · Pricing · Docs · Sign in" on the right, white text on the dark page.
Add a huge Helvetica heavy headline set tight (line-height 1), white text, exactly 2 lines: "Three layers" / "of calm." — keep these line breaks, each line stay
Add body paragraph text below the headline: "Budget, savings and spending, each on its own pane, all visible at once." in white Helvetica.
Add a pill-shaped button labelled "Start free" with a gradient fill from vivid indigo #7b5cff (left) to vivid light pink #ff5cc8 (right).
Add a layered glass stack of 3 overlapping frosted glass cards, absolutely placed in page px over the glows, each 24px rounded corners, see-through fill #ffffff
